summary: Prestige Consumer Healthcare Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Term Loan Credit Agreement amendment to borrow up to $95 million, which was drawn on July 1, 2026, to partially finance the acquisition of LaCorium Health Australia Pty Limited and related Australian entities (LaCorium Acquisition). The acquisition closed on July 1, 2026. The company also announced a $400 million private offering of senior unsecured notes due 2034. No board recommendation or advisors are named in the filing. The filing notes a separate previously announced acquisition. The structural mechanics involve incremental term loans and a concurrent note offering. Watch for details on the acquisition price and financing mix; risk-arb centers on integration and leverage.
